Nonempty branch chooses the left disjunct and must prove dataqueue_ready(dataqueue_pop q) before constructing the update wand. Derive max_len/front/rear bounds and slots length from ready. Prove count(pop q)=count q-1 and that each FIFO slot of pop q is the old FIFO slot at successor index (modular front wrap included); transport Forall initialized along that tail/subsequence using seq/map indices. All other ready fields and both semaphore IDs are unchanged. Split store_map once; within wand introduction merge the supplied new store_dataqueue at p into dataqueue_publish, retaining all other keys. Prove new map pure invariant by key=p vs key<>p; the latter uses old invariant, former uses pop-ready and unchanged semaphore association. Rebuild os_inv using replace_dataqueues projections; nonqueue frame and world conditions are unchanged. Keep InsideCritical and output slots untouched. No duplicate frame ownership and no assumed ready-obligation.
